Lena Ortiz: heads up — Merchantly (acct ****-5012) had a failed autopay this morning. two invoices impacted: M-2101 and M-2102.
Haris Farooq: decline reason? any AVS mismatch?
billing-bot: alert: payment_method=card_last4=5012 status=declined code=do_not_honor attempts=1
CS-Alex: spoke with their AP. they hit a daily card cap and asked if they can wire or put funds in escrow. want an expedited reconciliation once we see remittance.
Lena Ortiz: can we accept escrow? we generally prefer wire/ACH for settlement. if they insist on escrow, we need legal confirmation. ask them to wire to our treasury and include invoice refs.
Maya Singh: tagging compliance: if they request escrow, we need a signed escrow agreement. i can start the template but legal needs to sign off.
Haris Farooq: immediate ops: run one auto-retry now, then pause automated retries. set invoices to pending_payment. also send the minimal wire template (no acct in slack).
CS-Alex: pasted to customer: ``Beneficiary: Redwood Inference Inc.
Bank: First Partner Bank
Routing/SWIFT: [please confirm]
Reference: Merchantly + invoice numbers
Amount: USD XXXX``
CS-Alex: customer replied: "we'll initiate wire EOD; will upload proof of payment. if escrow needed, we'll sign. asked for a remittance email receipt."
Lena Ortiz: ok set ticket FIN-5580 to pending_wire. schedule manual follow-up in 48h. do not trigger dunning while client is actively communicating.
billing-bot: action logged: auto_retry=attempted timestamp=1773000150 result=failed; ticket=FIN-5580 status=pending_wire
Maya Singh: started escrow-thread with legal; attaching note in FIN-5580: "escrow requested by client; awaiting legal signoff".
Haris Farooq: add reconciliation note: once proof arrives, reconcile to invoice numbers and apply to oldest invoice first. if wire fails, offer ACH link: https://billing.redwood.ai/ach-setup.
Lena Ortiz: thanks — next check-in 1773003720 (~1hr). keep thread open until remittance posted. :thumbsup:
